metaDescription: Your account profile and security settings.
pageDescription: Manage your personal details, account security, and trusted browsers.
mockApi: My profile requires the live API. Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_MODE=python and sign in.
pictureDescription: Shown on your account and across the admin workspace.
imageHint: Square PNG, JPEG, or GIF under 10MB.
imagePreviewOnly: Image preview only. Upload to storage is not wired yet — use a profile image URL from your account.
yourDetailsDescription: How you appear to others in Zahrat Manisa.
namesRequired: First and last name are required.
dangerDescription: Delete your account and everything associated with it.
deleteAccountDescription: This permanently removes your profile and access. Enter your password to confirm.
changePasswordDescription: Sets a new password for your account. Requires at least 8 characters.
passwordMinLength: New password must be at least 8 characters.
passwordsDoNotMatch: New password and confirmation do not match.
twoFactorDescription: Adds a one-time code from your authenticator app on top of your password.
turnOffDescription: Your account will be protected by your password alone.
setUpDescription: Use the MFA API when backend enrollment is ready.
mfaPlaceholder: MFA UI placeholder — connect /api/v1/mfa when required.
trustedDescription: Browsers that can skip an extra sign-in check until they expire.
noTrustedBrowsersDescription: Trusted browsers appear here after you choose to trust one during sign-in.
removeBrowserDescription: {label} will need to sign in again before it can be trusted.
removeAllDescription: Every trusted browser will need to sign in again.
